# Florida Medical Malpractice Lawyers | Scott R. McMillen

> Scott R. McMillen specializes in Florida medical malpractice and personal injury cases with 33+ years of experience and multiple office locations across the state.

McMillen Law Firm is a dedicated medical malpractice practice serving Florida clients through offices in Jacksonville, Orlando, Tampa, and Tallahassee. The firm provides free case evaluations and handles complex medical negligence claims including Federal Tort Claims Act cases.
